members.name: key
members.doc: Stable identity. A series keeps its line across data changes, so switching ranges morphs the path instead of redrawing it.

members.name: label
members.doc: Name in the legend, the tooltip, and the data table.

members.name: color
members.doc: Any CSS color. Defaults to the accent for the first series, then quieter neutral steps.

members.name: dashed
members.doc: Draws a dashed stroke, useful for a previous period or a target.

members.name: area
members.doc: Fills the area under the line with a faint tint of its color. Defaults to true for the first series.

members.name: key
members.doc: Stable identity, such as an ISO date.

members.name: label
members.doc: Full label for the tooltip and screen readers, such as "Tue, Sep 15".

members.name: axisLabel
members.doc: Short label on the x axis, such as "Sep 15". Leave it out to keep the axis quiet at that point.

members.name: values
members.doc: One value per series key. A missing value counts as zero.

types.name: LineChartProps
types.doc: Use a line chart for one or more measures over time, when the shape of the trend matters more than any single value.

members.name: label
members.doc: What is measured, such as "Signups". Names the chart for assistive technology.

members.name: unit
members.doc: Unit after each value in the tooltip, such as "ms".

members.name: height
members.doc: Plot height in pixels. The width follows the container.

members.name: formatValue
members.doc: Formats values in the tooltip and data table.

members.name: formatTick
members.doc: Formats the value axis. Defaults to a compact number, such as 1.2K.

members.name: hiddenSeries
members.doc: Controlled hidden series keys.

members.name: onActiveChange
members.type: (index: number | null, datum: LineChartDatum | null) => void
members.doc: Called as the crosshair moves, and with null when it leaves. Use it to drive a headline readout.

members.name: loading
members.doc: Keeps the current lines on screen, dimmed, while the next range loads.

members.name: emptyLabel
members.doc: Shown when there are no points.

members.name: legend
members.doc: Series toggles above the plot. Shown by default when there is more than one series.

members.name: categoryLabel
members.doc: Header of the first column in the data table read by screen readers.

members.name: curve
members.doc: Smooth monotone curves that never swing past the data, or straight segments.
